card.question: Which annotation schemes separate stated / partial / unstated, and what agreement do comparable tasks reach against MS1's κ floor of 0.70?
card.answer: The 10 comparable values have a median of 0.725 (7 of 10 ≥ 0.70, range 0.62–0.81). The binary ones have a median of 0.75 (5 of 6). The one scheme with a partial class reaches 0.62.
card.changed: I4 gates MS1 on closed vs not closed at κ ≥ 0.70, with three-state agreement reported but not gated. Partial becomes a component count. Seed vs independent support is computed from metadata, not coded.

worked: κ 0.70 is reachable on a binary split: 5 of 6 binary comparable values are ≥ 0.70 (median 0.75).
failed: The only comparable scheme with a partial class misses 0.70 (WiCE α 0.62).
